yaya.rp.label: Roleplay
yaya.rp.desc: Adds a "Roleplay" workflow: a GameMaster guides you through the world you imagine in prose (pick it from the workflow menu once enabled)
yaya.rp.wf_desc: A GameMaster runs a text roleplay: send an intro to open, then c to continue / r to expand / prompt to export a save
yaya.rp.main_title: Protagonist (Settings → Plugins → Roleplay → Protagonist display name)
yaya.rp.cfg.protagonist_desc: Identity, personality, looks…; empty = from the intro or random. The story writes the protagonist as [[main]] and never names them
yaya.rp.cfg.main_name_desc: [[main]] in the story is shown as this name; empty = a "Protagonist" chip. Display only, the model never sees it
yaya.rp.cfg.genre_desc: Empty = summarized from the intro, or random
yaya.rp.cfg.detail_desc: 1 = brisk chronicle, 16 = every moment in rich detail; also sets the passage length
yaya.rp.cfg.memory_desc: After each passage a chronicler updates the summary, world and characters (one extra model call); needed for prompt export and long-story consistency
yaya.rp.mode.free: F Free: no options, asks whether to continue
yaya.rp.mode.interactive: I Interactive: offers a few options after each passage
yaya.rp.card.hint: Reply with feedback to rewrite the opening; c to start, r to expand, prompt to export, help for commands
yaya.rp.help.title: Roleplay commands
yaya.rp.help.markdown:
- `c [message]` continue the story, message optional
- `r <aspect>` expand on something without advancing the plot
- `prompt` export settings and world to continue in a new chat
- Other text: the intro before the opening, feedback on the opening, then the same as `c`
yaya.rp.export.title: Story save
yaya.rp.export.heading: Roleplay save
yaya.rp.export.hint: Start a new chat, choose the Roleplay workflow and send this whole text to continue.
yaya.rp.export.empty: No story yet, nothing to export.
